name: Easy Note
description: A powerful, multi-language drawing canvas for Obsidian. Features multi-color brushes, eraser, image layers (with multi-select), text layers, Markdown layers (with [[wikilink]] and [text](url)), named undo/redo, pan/hand tool, and export. Canvas state is saved as .enote. Touch, stylus, and i18n supported. Default language: English.
author: welcsy
